about: Written for this project (MIT). Pairs of concepts as two different textbook sections might describe them, used to set the similarity bands for merging duplicates (src/main/knowledge/merge.ts). 'same' pairs are one concept; 'different' pairs are related but distinct and must never be merged without the model or the user.

same: The matrix A^{-1} such that A A^{-1} = A^{-1} A = I.
A square matrix B with AB = BA = I, the identity matrix.
The sum of the products of matching components of two vectors.
Multiply corresponding entries of u and v and add the results.
Subtracting multiples of one equation from others to reach an upper triangular system.
A method that uses row operations to turn Ax = b into an upper triangular system Ux = c.
Vectors are independent when no combination except the zero combination gives the zero vector.
A set of vectors in which the only solution of c1v1 + ... + cnvn = 0 is all c = 0.
The set of all input values for which the function is defined.
All inputs x that a function accepts.
A number computed from a square matrix that is zero exactly when the matrix is singular.
The scalar det A, which changes sign when two rows are exchanged and is zero for singular A.
A number lambda with Ax = lambda x for some nonzero vector x.
Scalars lambda for which A - lambda I is singular.
All linear combinations of the columns of A.
The subspace C(A) spanned by the columns of A.
The ratio of the change in y to the change in x between two points on the line.
Rise over run: how much y changes for each unit change in x.
The entry in row i, column j of AB is the dot product of row i of A with column j of B.
AB is defined when A has as many columns as B has rows; each entry is a row times a column.
different: The sum of the products of matching components of two vectors.
A vector perpendicular to two vectors in three dimensions, with length |u||v| sin theta.
The matrix A^{-1} such that A A^{-1} = I.
The function f^{-1} that undoes f, so f^{-1}(f(x)) = x.
The set of all input values for which the function is defined.
The set of all output values a function produces.
All linear combinations of the columns of A.
A number lambda with Ax = lambda x for some nonzero vector x.
A nonzero vector x whose direction is unchanged by A: Ax = lambda x.
A number computed from a square matrix that is zero exactly when the matrix is singular.
The sum of the diagonal entries of a square matrix.
No combination except the zero combination gives the zero vector.
The set of all linear combinations of a set of vectors.
Row operations that reach an upper triangular system.
Solving an upper triangular system from the last equation upward.
A matrix equal to its transpose.
The matrix whose rows are the columns of A.
The number of pivots, equal to the dimension of the column space.
The number of vectors in any basis of the subspace.
Rise over run between two points.
The value of y where the line crosses the y-axis.
Each entry of AB is a row of A times a column of B.
Adding two matrices of the same size entry by entry.
